policy: Every model below was trained with leakage-checked features and grouped validation. Small-sample models are labelled exploratory. No model is a flight-qualified safety device.

models.task: binary classification — will a CFI-G inverse-config gaseous flame achieve hot ignition?
models.validation: StratifiedGroupKFold n=4 grouped by test Day (12 groups); calibration via sigmoid CV

inBrowserScoring.note: Apply to z-scored features using means/stds below; score = sigmoid(intercept + X·coef).

limitations: Small sample (146 labelled rows, 15 negatives) — exploratory evidence, not a flight-qualifiable predictor.
Groups are test days; day-specific operator/setup effects are partially controlled but not fully independent.
Applicability domain limited to CFI-G inverse configuration (ethane/propane/butane, XO2 0.15–0.5, ~1 bar).
'flash' outcomes (8 rows) are excluded as ambiguous — never counted as negatives.
models.statusDetail: Small-sample exploratory model. The calibrated multivariate logistic model does NOT yet outperform the single-feature XO2 baseline (see metrics) — reported honestly rather than tuned away. Retained as a registered, reproducible baseline for future data.

models.task: regression — log flame burn duration (s) of SPICE co-flow smoke-point tests

dataset.target: ln(1 + burn duration seconds), burn duration = GMT Flame Off − GMT ignition

models.validation: GroupKFold n=4 grouped by GMT test date
limitations: Burn duration is derived from operator-logged GMT timestamps; timestamp resolution and logging practice vary.
Duplicate timestamps appear in the source (replicate records) — grouped validation mitigates but does not eliminate overlap effects.
Applicability domain limited to SPICE fuels/nozzles/flow ranges; extrapolation unsupported.
models.statusDetail: Neither ridge nor gradient boosting beats the per-fuel mean-duration baseline under grouped (by-date) validation. Honest conclusion: pre-test features in this table do not generalise across test dates for burn duration. Retained for transparency and future re-evaluation; NOT offered as a predictor in the UI playground.
